data.title: 爱宕 · 月下床榻的薄纱黑袍
data.description: 静谧卧房的落地窗前月华如练。爱宕身穿黑色半透真丝睡袍跪坐在床垫中央，领口微松展现出令人屏息的曼妙曲线与如脂雪肌。犬耳随着心跳轻微摇动，金色眸子中水光潋滟，她单手轻抚胸前微敞的丝绸，神情极尽温存而又饱含对心上人的无限倾慕。
data.location: dim moonlit bedroom with sheer curtains
data.action: kneeling gracefully in center of bed under moonlight, sheer black silk peignoir robe sliding off shoulder, golden eyes glowing with love, dog ears twitched with emotion
data.lighting: cool silver moonlight filtering through transparent curtains onto dark sheets
data.mood: breathtaking sensual devotion, elegant private allure
data.promptProse: Kneeling gracefully in the center of a bed bathed in moonlight, Atago wears a sheer black silk peignoir that slips off her bare shoulder. Her dog ears perk gently as she looks forward with deep devotion.
data.animaCaption: Atago kneeling on a bed in a sheer black silk robe under cool silver moonlight.
